conf.description: Forcepoint Security Manager audit log, key-value predefined SIEM string: capture positional sourceServer, kvp-deserialize action/user/reason/product_version, split sourceServer into host.target.ip/name, tag event.dataset; _raw retained (low-volume, forensically valuable); reason/_details previous-vs-current split deferred as an undocumented-format gap.

conf.comment: Forcepoint Web Security, audit-log dataset, syslog-kv format (predefined string: vendor=Forcepoint product=Security product_version=... action=... user=... reason=...). sourceServer is a positional hostname token before the kv pairs begin, not a kv pair itself. GAP: recommendations.direct.cribl calls for splitting the packed reason/_details blob into previous/current values, but the work order gives no delimiter or example for that packing, so it is stored intact rather than guessed - see README.

functions.description: identify pipeline and note the reason/_details split gap
Capture the positional sourceServer hostname token that precedes the vendor=Forcepoint kv block
Message body: a Cribl Syslog Source leaves the full line, header included, in _raw and the body in message; anything else carries the body in _raw.
Split sourceServer into host.target.ip/name (machine acted upon, not the emitter); tag event.dataset; drop constant vendor/product noise fields
Batch rename every status:mapped/unmapped-with-custom-target field to its ECS or custom home
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
